summaries.title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks

summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Together, these advances establish an Ascend-oriented training foundation for the continued development of Xing 4 across model scales and increasingly demanding reasoning and agent...）。
